mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_record (user_id, bank_id, dept_id, total_count, correct_count, score, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{bankId}, #{deptId}, #{totalCount}, #{correctCount}, #{score}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.bank_id, r.dept_id, r.total_count, r.correct_count, r.score, r.create_time, b.bank_name FROM practice_record r LEFT JOIN question_bank b ON b.id = r.bank_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, r.bank_id, r.dept_id, r.total_count, r.correct_count, r.score, r.create_time, b.bank_name FROM practice_record r LEFT JOIN question_bank b ON b.id = r.bank_id WHERE r.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
